summary: Tenant alias canonicalization prevents service-account role resolution in private deployment
description:
Issue summary:
Acme Health reports intermittent 403s for scheduled workers and CI service-accounts after they introduced tenant aliases (legacy -> canonical). The private control plane was updated to accept the alias list in the tenant mapping; however, identity-proxy canonicalization step normalizes incoming X-Tenant headers to canonical form before authz lookup, causing service-account assertions that present alias-form audience to fail role resolution. Impact: scheduled batch jobs and some admin service operations cannot access internal APIs (authz returns 403).
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Deploy private control plane with tenant alias mapping: tenant 'acme-legacy' aliased to 'acme'.
2) Issue a service-account JWT where 'aud' is set to 'acme-legacy' (common for older provisioning).
3) Send request through identity-proxy to internal admin API with X-Tenant header set to 'acme-legacy'.
4) Observe 403 from authz-service and missing role bindings in role-resolution logs.
logs: identity-proxy: INFO request id=01FZ3Z... headers=X-Tenant=acme-legacy, Authorization=Bearer <redacted>
identity-proxy: DEBUG canonicalized tenant='acme' from header 'acme-legacy'
authz-service: WARN request id=01FZ3Z... principal='svc-worker@acme-legacy' role_lookup_failed tenant='acme'
authz-service: ERROR role resolution: no bindings found for principal subject 'svc-worker@acme-legacy' (expected principal namespace 'acme-legacy')
scheduled-worker: ERROR job-id=job-1123 403 Forbidden from api.internal.redwood
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: token audience mismatch after tenant canonicalization results in principal namespace mismatch during role lookup.
Confirmed via logs that identity-proxy rewrites X-Tenant header to canonical value before authz-service sees the request.
Authz-service stores role bindings keyed by tenant-namespace as-presented in token subject/aud claims; older service-accounts still use alias namespace, so lookup fails.
Reproduced locally by constructing JWTs with alias aud and verifying role resolution fails when proxy canonicalizes header.
Temporary workaround validated: preserve original X-Tenant header in 'X-Tenant-Orig' and enable authz-service to consult alias map for subject lookup.
Related config change: customer enabled tenant_aliases in control plane on 2026-03-08 (see deployment logs).
comments: 2026-03-10 09:12 - Aisha Patel (Support): Received report from Acme Health. They saw ~40% of scheduled workers failing with 403s since tenant alias rollout.
2026-03-10 10:04 - Owen Murphy (SRE): Collected proxy and authz logs. Observed canonicalization step rewriting header prior to role lookup. Assigned to identity-proxy and authz owners for patch.

2026-03-11 14:22 - Marco Chen (Identity Eng): Confirmed root cause: canonicalization happens in the proxy's 'tenant_normalize' middleware before audit context set. Proposed patch: attach X-Tenant-Orig and add alias-aware lookup in authz-service.

2026-03-12 08:07 - Customer (Acme Health - SRE team): Accepted workaround (pinning new tenants in job configs) but asked for a safe server-side mitigation as they cannot re-issue all service-account tokens immediately.
2026-03-12 16:35 - Marco Chen (Identity Eng): Created PR 2123 to identity-proxy and PR 2125 to authz-service to support alias-aware principal lookup. Deployed to staging for validation.

2026-03-13 05:58 - Owen Murphy (SRE): Hotfix deployed to prod behind a config flag 'authz.alias_lookup=true'. Ran smoke tests and validated scheduled jobs recover. Monitoring shows error rate dropped to baseline.
2026-03-13 12:40 - Aisha Patel (Support): Confirmed with customer that affected jobs resumed. Marking ticket resolved; will follow up with postmortem and recommendations.
resolution: Deploy a two-part fix: (1) identity-proxy now preserves original tenant header in X-Tenant-Orig and sets X-Tenant-Canonical; (2) authz-service consults tenant alias map during principal resolution when X-Tenant-Orig is present. Hotfix gated behind 'authz.alias_lookup' flag rolled out 2026-03-13. Customer rollback option: pin tenant header in scheduled-worker config to 'acme' or re-issue tokens with canonical aud. Follow-up: full migration guide for tenant alias rollout and a postmortem posted at https://confluence.redwood.com/postmortems/SUP-422789.
